cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I said I'd carry one box. That warehouse isn't the box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help me move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. With one box. We admired how manageable the sentence was.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Make it the biggest one, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. The word 'one' has retained its dignity.

mechanism: Copy a mover's tick without understanding it marks empty cartons, then preserve only the literal one-box promise as B clarifies the actual work.
confusable: Not any refusal to help: A must agree to a specific phrase and keep narrowing it while confidently covering the copied-mark mistake.
comparison: One moving box and size versus a day of dog-sitting and midnight.
seedUse: Retains one-box limit and biggest-box concession; adds ticked empty carton mistaken for selected load.
